+ +async function install([root, branch, head, candidate, message, objects, pack, index, nextIndex, backup, baseRef, baseHead]: string[]): Promise<void> {
+ +  if (!root || !branch || !head || !candidate || !message || !objects || !pack || !index || !nextIndex || backup === undefined) throw new Error("팀 마감 Git 반영 인자 누락");
+ +  if (!refPattern.test(branch) || !oidPattern.test(head) || !oidPattern.test(candidate)) throw new Error("팀 마감 Git 참조 형식 오류");
+ +  const base = baseRef && baseHead && baseRef !== branch ? verify(baseRef, baseHead) : "";
+ +  await lockedRefs(root, `update ${branch} ${candidate} ${head}\n${base}`, async (commit) => {
+ +    // Keep index.lock in place while replacing the index from a sibling on the same filesystem.
+ +    renameSync(nextIndex, index);
+ +    try {
+ +      const blobPack = openSync(pack, "r");
+ +      try {
+ +        const copied = spawnSync("git", ["-C", root, "index-pack", "--stdin"], { env, stdio: [blobPack, "pipe", "pipe"], timeout: 120_000 });
+ +        if (copied.status !== 0) throw new Error("검증한 팀 마감 Git 객체를 반영하지 못했다");
+ +      } finally { closeSync(blobPack); }
+ +      await commit();
+ +    } catch (error) {
+ +      // If commit acknowledgement was interrupted, first determine which index belongs to the branch.
+ +      try {
+ +        const current = git(root, ["rev-parse", "--verify", branch]);
+ +        if (current === candidate) return;
+ +        if (current !== head) throw new Error("현재 브랜치가 후보나 기존 HEAD와 일치하지 않는다");
+ +        if (backup) renameSync(backup, index); else unlinkSync(index);
+ +      } catch (restoreError) {
+ +        throw new IndexRecoveryRequired(`팀 마감 인덱스 복원 실패. 복구 자료 경로: ${dirname(nextIndex)}\n${String(error)}\n${String(restoreError)}`);
+ +      }
+ +      throw error;
+ +    }
+ +  }, { message, objects });
+ +}
+ +
+ +try {
+ +  const [mode, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2);
+ +  if (mode === "legacy") await legacy(args);
+ +  else if (mode === "install") await install(args);
+ +  else throw new Error("팀 마감 Git 반영 모드 오류");
+ +} catch (error) {
+ +  process.stderr.write(`${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}\n`);
+ +  process.exitCode = error instanceof IndexRecoveryRequired ? 3 : 1;
+ +}

+ +export function writeTeamFinish(root: string, project: string, id: string, git: Git, checked?: { tree: string; parent: string; checkStatus: CheckStatus }): void {

+ +function sealEntry(git: Git, target: string, path: string): string | undefined {
+ +  const entry = run(git, ["--literal-pathspecs", "ls-tree", "-z", target, "--", path]);
+ +  if (!/^100(?:644|755) blob [a-f0-9]+\t/.test(entry)) return undefined;
+ +  const size = Number(run(git, ["cat-file", "-s", `${target}:${path}`]));
+ +  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(size) || size > 4096) return undefined;
+ +  return blob(git, target, path);
+ +}

+ +function changedHistory(git: Git, target: string, path: string): string[] {
+ +  const history = run(git, ["--literal-pathspecs", "log", "--full-history", "--format=%H", target, "--", path]);
+ +  const commits = history.split("\n").filter(Boolean);
+ +  if (!commits.every(oid)) throw new HandoffError("팀 finish Git 이력 대조 실패");
+ +  return commits;
+ +}

+ +function hasTeamHistoryAtPath(project: string, id: string, target: string, git: Git): boolean {
+ +  const path = `${project}/${teamFinishFile}`;
+ +  for (const commit of changedHistory(git, target, path)) {
+ +    const content = sealEntry(git, commit, path);
+ +    if (content === undefined) continue;
+ +    let expected: string;
+ +    try { expected = seal(strictJson(content), id).tree; } catch { continue; }
+ +    if (withoutSeal(git, `${commit}^{tree}`, path) === expected) return true;
+ +  }
+ +
+ +  // Current files may have been removed during rebase before a seal could be written.
+ +  const measurement = `${project}/TEAM-MEASUREMENT.json`;
+ +  for (const commit of changedHistory(git, target, measurement)) {
+ +    if (run(git, ["--literal-pathspecs", "ls-tree", "-z", commit, "--", measurement])) return true;
+ +  }
+ +  // Marker meaning can change when a surrounding fence/comment changes instead of the marker line.
+ +  for (const [name, adopted] of [
+ +    ["PROJECT.md", (text: string) => inspectTeamMarker(text).state === "active"],
+ +    ["log.jsonl", (text: string) => hasTeamContract(id, "", false, eventLines(text))],
+ +  ] as const) {
+ +    const source = `${project}/${name}`, checked = new Set<string>();
+ +    for (const commit of changedHistory(git, target, source)) {
+ +      const entry = run(git, ["--literal-pathspecs", "ls-tree", "-z", commit, "--", source]);
+ +      const oid = /^100(?:644|755) blob ([a-f0-9]+)\t/.exec(entry)?.[1];
+ +      if (!oid || checked.has(oid)) continue;
+ +      checked.add(oid);
+ +      if (adopted(blob(git, commit, source))) return true;
+ +    }
+ +  }
+ +  return false;
+ +}

+ +export function hasTeamFinishHistory(project: string, id: string, target: string, git: Git): boolean {
+ +  if (!/^P\d{3}$/.test(id)) throw new HandoffError("팀 채택 Git 이력의 프로젝트 번호 오류");
+ +  if (hasTeamHistoryAtPath(project, id, target, git)) return true;
+ +  // Git rename detection depends on content similarity. The project number is the stable identity.
+ +  const paths = run(git, ["log", "--full-history", "--name-only", "--format=", "-z", target, "--", `:(glob)projects/${id}_*/PROJECT.md`]);
+ +  const previousPaths = new Set(paths.split("\0").filter(Boolean).map((path) => path.trimEnd().replace(/\/PROJECT\.md$/, "")));
+ +  previousPaths.delete(project);
+ +  return [...previousPaths].some((prior) => prior.startsWith(`projects/${id}_`) && prior.split("/").length === 2 && hasTeamHistoryAtPath(prior, id, target, git));
+ +}

+ +/** Returns the captured commit for adopted projects, also when their worktree is absent. */
+ +export function checkedTeamTarget(project: string, id: string, target: string, git: Git): { target: string; checkStatus: CheckStatus | "unrecorded" } | undefined {
+ +  const projectText = blob(git, target, `${project}/PROJECT.md`);
+ +  const listed = run(git, ["--literal-pathspecs", "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "-z", target, "--", project]).split("\0");
+ +  const events = listed.includes(`${project}/log.jsonl`) ? eventLines(blob(git, target, `${project}/log.jsonl`)) : [];
+ +  const adopted = hasTeamContract(id, projectText, listed.includes(`${project}/TEAM-MEASUREMENT.json`), events);
+ +  const rel = `${project}/${teamFinishFile}`;
+ +  const current = listed.includes(rel) ? sealEntry(git, target, rel) : undefined;
+ +  let expected: ReturnType<typeof seal> | undefined;
+ +  if (current !== undefined) {
+ +    try { expected = seal(strictJson(current), id); }
+ +    catch (error) { if (adopted) throw error; }
+ +  }
+ +  if (expected === undefined) {
+ +    if (!adopted && !hasTeamFinishHistory(project, id, target, git)) return undefined;
+ +    throw new HandoffError("팀 finish 영수증이 없거나 유효하지 않다: 팀 측정 입력을 확인하고 worktree에서 finish를 다시 실행한다");
+ +  }
+ +  if (withoutSeal(git, `${target}^{tree}`, rel) !== expected.tree) throw new HandoffError("팀 finish 뒤 내용이 바뀌었다: worktree에서 finish를 다시 실행한다");
+ +  const parents = run(git, ["rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", target]).split(" ");
+ +  if (parents.length !== 2 || parents[1] !== expected.checkedParent) {
+ +    throw new HandoffError("팀 finish 대상의 부모가 검사한 커밋과 다르거나 미확인이다: worktree에서 finish를 다시 실행한다");
+ +  }
+ +  return { target, checkStatus: expected.checkStatus };
+ +}

+ +class UnsafeTeamMetadataError extends HandoffError {}
+ +export function natural(value: unknown): value is number { return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && (value as number) >= 0; }
+ +export function nullableNatural(value: unknown): value is number | null { return value === null || natural(value); }
+ +export function iso(value: unknown): value is string { return typeof value === "string" && /^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT.*(?:Z|[+-]\d\d:\d\d)$/.test(value) && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)); }
+ +export function metadataValue(bytes: Buffer): unknown {
+ +  const text = utf8(bytes);
+ +  if (hasSecret(text)) throw new UnsafeTeamMetadataError("팀 metadata 비밀 후보 거부");
+ +  return strictJson(text);
+ +}
+ +export function metadataJson(path: string, limit = 32768, inputs?: InputTrace): unknown {
+ +  const bytes = regularBytes(path, limit), value = metadataValue(bytes);
+ +  inputs?.record(path, inputHash(bytes));
+ +  return value;
+ +}
+ +function safeEvidenceLocator(value: unknown): value is string {
+ +  if (!sourceRef(value)) return false;
+ +  const locator = value.replaceAll("\\", "/").toLowerCase();
+ +  return !locator.includes("/") && !locator.startsWith("file:") &&
+ +    (!locator.startsWith("local:") || /^local:[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(locator));
+ +}
+ +function teamReferencePath(dir: string, ref: unknown): string {
+ +  if (!shortText(ref, 240) || isAbsolute(ref) || ref.includes("\\") ||
+ +      ref.split("/").some((part) => !part || part === "." || part === ".." || part.toLowerCase() === ".git")) {
+ +    throw new HandoffError("팀 근거는 프로젝트 안의 짧은 metadata JSON 영수증이어야 한다");
+ +  }
+ +  const slash = ref.lastIndexOf("/");
+ +  // Validate ancestor directories here. regularBytes inspects the leaf on its first read.
+ +  const parent = slash === -1 ? resolve(dir) : safeTeamPath(dir, ref.slice(0, slash), true);
+ +  return join(parent, ref.slice(slash + 1));
+ +}
+ +/** Older logs accepted equivalent relative spellings. Keep their words and resolve the same file. */
+ +export function canonicalTeamLogRef(ref: string): string {
+ +  const portable = ref.replaceAll("\\", "/");
+ +  const parts = portable.split("/");
+ +  if (portable.startsWith("/") || /^[a-z]:/i.test(portable) || parts.includes("..")) {
+ +    throw new HandoffError("팀 로그 영수증 경로는 프로젝트 안의 상대 경로여야 한다");
+ +  }
+ +  return parts.filter((part) => part && part !== ".").join("/");
+ +}
+ +function assertNoLiteralBackslashPath(dir: string, ref: string, inputs?: InputTrace): void {
+ +  if (process.platform === "win32" || !ref.includes("\\")) return;
+ +  // A backslash can also be a literal filename on POSIX. Never stage that second interpretation.
+ +  const parts = ref.split("/").filter((part) => part && part !== ".");
+ +  const target = resolve(dir, ...parts);
+ +  let path = resolve(dir);
+ +  for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+ +    path = join(path, part);
+ +    let entry: ReturnType<typeof lstatSync>;
+ +    try { entry = lstatSync(path); }
+ +    catch (error) {
+ +      if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== "ENOENT") throw error;
+ +      inputs?.absent?.(target);
+ +      return;
+ +    }
+ +    if (index === parts.length - 1 || !entry.isDirectory() || entry.isSymbolicLink()) {
+ +      throw new HandoffError("팀 로그 영수증에 역슬래시를 문자로 쓰는 별도 파일 경로가 있다");
+ +    }
+ +  }
+ +}
+ +function evidencePath(dir: string, ref: unknown): string {
+ +  if (typeof ref !== "string" || !ref.endsWith(".json")) throw new HandoffError("팀 영수증은 JSON 일반 파일이어야 한다");
+ +  return teamReferencePath(dir, ref);
+ +}
+ +function validateReceipt(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
+ +  fields(value, ["version", "kind", "sourceRef", "hash", "requestId", "decisionReplyId", "period", "purposes"], ["version", "kind", "sourceRef", "hash"]);
+ +  if (typeof value.sourceRef === "string" && (/[/\\]/.test(value.sourceRef) || /^file:/i.test(value.sourceRef))) {
+ +    throw new UnsafeTeamMetadataError("팀 근거 출처에 파일 경로를 쓸 수 없다");
+ +  }
+ +  if (value.version !== 1 || value.kind !== "team-evidence" || !safeEvidenceLocator(value.sourceRef) || !hashValue(value.hash) || value.requestId !== undefined && !identifier(value.requestId) || value.decisionReplyId !== undefined && !identifier(value.decisionReplyId)) throw new HandoffError("팀 근거 영수증 형식/출처/지문 오류");
+ +  if (value.purposes !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(value.purposes) || value.purposes.length > EVIDENCE_PURPOSES.length || new Set(value.purposes).size !== value.purposes.length || value.purposes.some((p) => !EVIDENCE_PURPOSES.includes(p as EvidencePurpose)))) throw new HandoffError("팀 근거 용도 형식 오류");
+ +  if (value.period !== undefined) {
+ +    fields(value.period, ["start", "end", "unit"]);
+ +    if (!iso(value.period.start) || !iso(value.period.end) || Date.parse(value.period.start) > Date.parse(value.period.end) || !["project-start-to-merge", "representative-task"].includes(value.period.unit as string)) throw new HandoffError("완료 영수증 구간 형식 오류");
+ +  }
+ +  return value;
+ +}
+ +/** Only a typed, versionable locator receipt is proof input; raw local body paths/text are never proof files. */
+ +export function evidenceReceipt(dir: string, ref: unknown, inputs?: InputTrace): Record<string, unknown> {
+ +  return validateReceipt(metadataJson(evidencePath(dir, ref), 16384, inputs));
+ +}
+ +/** Whole-scope authority cannot be borrowed from a per-request receipt. */
+ +export function receiptPurpose(evidence: Record<string, unknown>, purpose: EvidencePurpose, requestId?: string): boolean {
+ +  if (purpose === "coordinator-answer" && evidence.decisionReplyId !== undefined) return false;
+ +  return Array.isArray(evidence.purposes) && evidence.purposes.includes(purpose) && (requestId === undefined ? evidence.requestId === undefined && evidence.decisionReplyId === undefined : evidence.requestId === requestId);
+ +}
+ +interface Receipt { evidence: Record<string, unknown>; sha256: string }
+ +type ReceiptRead = { kind: "available"; receipt: Receipt; dir: string; ref: unknown } | { kind: "absent" | "unavailable" };
+ +
+ +function captureReceipt(path: string, dir: string, ref: unknown): ReceiptRead {
+ +  let bytes: Buffer;
+ +  try { bytes = regularBytes(path, 16384); }
+ +  catch (error) {
+ +    if (error instanceof HandoffSizeError) return { kind: "unavailable" };
+ +    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return { kind: "absent" };
+ +    throw error;
+ +  }
+ +  try {
+ +    const evidence = validateReceipt(metadataValue(bytes));
+ +    return { kind: "available", receipt: { evidence, sha256: inputHash(bytes) }, dir, ref };
+ +  } catch (error) {
+ +    if (error instanceof UnsafeTeamMetadataError || !(error instanceof HandoffError || error instanceof SyntaxError)) throw error;
+ +    return { kind: "unavailable" };
+ +  }
+ +}
+ +
+ +/** Share the first receipt observation across every use of its path in one query. */
+ +export class TeamReceiptReads {
+ +  private readonly reads = new Map<string, ReceiptRead>();
+ +
+ +  read(dir: string, ref: unknown, inputs?: InputTrace): Receipt | null {
+ +    const path = evidencePath(dir, ref);
+ +    let first = this.reads.get(path);
+ +    if (!first) {
+ +      first = captureReceipt(path, dir, ref);
+ +      this.reads.set(path, first);
+ +    }
+ +    if (first.kind === "absent") inputs?.absent?.(path);
+ +    if (first.kind !== "available") return null;
+ +    inputs?.record(path, first.receipt.sha256);
+ +    return first.receipt;
+ +  }
+ +
+ +  require(dir: string, ref: unknown, inputs?: InputTrace): Receipt {
+ +    const receipt = this.read(dir, ref, inputs);
+ +    if (!receipt) throw new HandoffError("팀 영수증 메타데이터의 형식 또는 가용성을 확인할 수 없다");
+ +    return receipt;
+ +  }
+ +
+ +  requireIfPresent(dir: string, originalRef: string, inputs?: InputTrace): void {
+ +    const ref = canonicalTeamLogRef(originalRef);
+ +    const path = teamReferencePath(dir, ref);
+ +    assertNoLiteralBackslashPath(dir, originalRef, inputs);
+ +    if (!ref.endsWith(".json")) {
+ +      try { lstatSync(path); }
+ +      catch (error) {
+ +        if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== "ENOENT") throw error;
+ +        inputs?.absent?.(path);
+ +        return;
+ +      }
+ +      throw new HandoffError("팀 로그에 인용된 파일은 JSON 영수증이어야 한다");
+ +    }
+ +    if (!this.read(dir, ref, inputs) && this.reads.get(path)?.kind !== "absent") {
+ +      throw new HandoffError("팀 로그 영수증의 메타데이터를 확인할 수 없다");
+ +    }
+ +  }
+ +
+ +  assertStable(): void {
+ +    for (const read of this.reads.values()) {
+ +      if (read.kind !== "available") continue;
+ +      try {
+ +        const current = regularBytes(evidencePath(read.dir, read.ref), 16384);
+ +        if (inputHash(current) === read.receipt.sha256) continue;
+ +      } catch { /* A formerly usable receipt cannot be verified. */ }
+ +      throw new InputSnapshotError("검증 중 입력이 바뀌었다: 팀 영수증을 확인하고 다시 실행한다");
+ +    }
+ +  }
+ +}
+ +export function readCompletionProof(receipts: TeamReceiptReads, dir: string, period: TeamPeriod, inputs?: InputTrace): { sha256: string; representativeScope: boolean } | null {
+ +  if (!period.closed || !period.start || !period.completionRef) return null;
+ +  const receipt = receipts.read(dir, period.completionRef, inputs);
+ +  if (!receipt) return null;
+ +  const { evidence, sha256 } = receipt;
+ +  if (!receiptPurpose(evidence, "completion") || !sameReceiptPeriod(evidence.period, period)) return null;
+ +  const prefix = "representative-scope:", locator = evidence.sourceRef as string;
+ +  const origin = locator.slice(prefix.length);
+ +  const representativeScope = locator.startsWith(prefix) && !origin.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefix) && safeEvidenceLocator(origin);
+ +  return { sha256, representativeScope };
+ +}
+ +export function representativeProofBinding(period: TeamPeriod, completion: { sha256: string } | null): RequestSupportReceipt | null {
+ +  return period.unit === "representative-task" && period.completionRef && completion
+ +    ? { ref: period.completionRef, receiptSha256: completion.sha256 }
+ +    : null;
+ +}
+ +export function observationCovered(dir: string, ref: unknown, period: TeamPeriod, role: string, kind: "activity" | "none", inputs?: InputTrace, receipts = new TeamReceiptReads()): boolean {
+ +  const receipt = receipts.read(dir, ref, inputs);
+ +  if (!receipt) return false;
+ +  const { evidence } = receipt;
+ +  const prefix = `role-observation:${role}:${kind}:`;
+ +  const locator = evidence.sourceRef as string, inner = locator.slice(prefix.length);
+ +  return locator.startsWith(prefix) && !inner.toLowerCase().startsWith("role-observation:") && safeEvidenceLocator(inner) &&
+ +    receiptPurpose(evidence, "role-observation") && sameReceiptPeriod(evidence.period, period);
+ +}
+ +function sameReceiptPeriod(p: unknown, period: TeamPeriod): boolean {
+ +  return object(p) && period.start !== null && p.unit === period.unit &&
+ +    Date.parse(p.start as string) === Date.parse(period.start) && Date.parse(p.end as string) === Date.parse(period.end);
+ +}
+ +function receiptMatches(receipts: TeamReceiptReads, dir: string, ref: unknown, purpose: EvidencePurpose, period?: TeamPeriod, requestId?: string, inputs?: InputTrace, matchedInputs?: InputTrace): boolean {
+ +  const trace = matchedInputs ? new InputSnapshot() : undefined;
+ +  const receipt = receipts.read(dir, ref, trace ?? inputs);
+ +  const matches = !!receipt && receiptPurpose(receipt.evidence, purpose, requestId) &&
+ +    (period === undefined || sameReceiptPeriod(receipt.evidence.period, period));
+ +  trace?.include(inputs);
+ +  if (matches) trace?.include(matchedInputs);
+ +  return matches;
+ +}
+ +function coverageMatches(receipts: TeamReceiptReads, dir: string, c: Coverage | undefined, purpose: EvidencePurpose, period?: TeamPeriod, requestId?: string, inputs?: InputTrace, matchedInputs?: InputTrace): boolean {
+ +  return confirmed(c) && receiptMatches(receipts, dir, c!.confirmationRef, purpose, period, requestId, inputs, matchedInputs) && c!.refs.some((ref) => receiptMatches(receipts, dir, ref, purpose, period, requestId, inputs, matchedInputs));
+ +}
+ +function referenceList(value: unknown): unknown[] {
+ +  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length > 32) throw new HandoffError("팀 근거 목록은32개 이하여야 한다");
+ +  return value;
+ +}
+ +export function proofRefs(dir: string, value: unknown, inputs?: InputTrace): string[] {
+ +  for (const ref of referenceList(value)) evidenceReceipt(dir, ref, inputs);
+ +  return value as string[];
+ +}
+ +function coverageRefs(c: Coverage): string[] {
+ +  return c.confirmationRef === undefined ? c.refs : [...c.refs, c.confirmationRef];
+ +}
+ +function coverage(value: unknown): Coverage {
+ +  fields(value, ["status", "reportedBy", "verifiedBy", "confirmationRef", "refs"], ["status", "reportedBy", "refs"]);
+ +  if (!["complete", "partial", "unknown"].includes(value.status as string) || !actor(value.reportedBy) || value.verifiedBy !== undefined && !actor(value.verifiedBy)) throw new HandoffError("팀 coverage 신고/확인 주체 오류");
+ +  referenceList(value.refs);
+ +  return value as unknown as Coverage;
+ +}
+ +export function confirmed(c: Coverage | undefined): boolean { return !!c && c.status === "complete" && !!c.verifiedBy && c.verifiedBy !== c.reportedBy && !!c.confirmationRef && c.refs.length > 0; }
+ +export function scopeConfirmed(receipts: TeamReceiptReads, dir: string, c: Coverage | undefined, period: TeamPeriod, purpose: EvidencePurpose, inputs?: InputTrace): boolean {
+ +  return coverageMatches(receipts, dir, c, purpose, period, undefined, inputs);
+ +}
+ +export function scopeObserved(receipts: TeamReceiptReads, dir: string, c: Coverage, period: TeamPeriod, purpose: EvidencePurpose, inputs?: InputTrace): boolean {
+ +  return c.status !== "unknown" && c.refs.some((ref) => receiptMatches(receipts, dir, ref, purpose, period, undefined, inputs));
+ +}
+ +function requestCoverageReceipt(receipts: TeamReceiptReads, dir: string, ref: string, period: TeamPeriod, fingerprint: string, inputs?: InputTrace, expectedSha256?: string): RequestCoverageProof | null {
+ +  const receipt = receipts.read(dir, ref, inputs);
+ +  if (!receipt || expectedSha256 !== undefined && receipt.sha256 !== expectedSha256) return null;
+ +  const { evidence, sha256 } = receipt, prefix = "request-coverage:";
+ +  const locator = evidence.sourceRef as string, origin = locator.slice(prefix.length);
+ +  return locator.startsWith(prefix) && !origin.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefix) && safeEvidenceLocator(origin) &&
+ +    evidence.hash === fingerprint && receiptPurpose(evidence, "request-coverage") &&
+ +    (evidence.purposes as unknown[]).length === 1 && sameReceiptPeriod(evidence.period, period)
+ +    ? { ref, inputSha256: fingerprint, receiptSha256: sha256 }
+ +    : null;
+ +}
+ +export function readRequestSupportingReceipts(receipts: TeamReceiptReads, dir: string, files: readonly { ref: string; receiptSha256?: string }[], period: TeamPeriod, inputs?: InputTrace): RequestSupportReceipt[] | null {
+ +  const support = files.map(({ ref, receiptSha256 }) => {
+ +    const read = receipts.read(dir, ref, inputs);
+ +    return read && (receiptSha256 === undefined || read.sha256 === receiptSha256) ? { ref, ...read } : null;
+ +  });
+ +  if (!support.every((receipt) => receipt !== null) ||
+ +      !support.some(({ evidence }) => receiptPurpose(evidence, "request-coverage") && sameReceiptPeriod(evidence.period, period))) return null;
+ +  return support.map(({ ref, sha256 }) => ({ ref, receiptSha256: sha256 }));
+ +}
+ +export function readRequestCoverageProof(receipts: TeamReceiptReads, dir: string, c: Coverage | undefined, period: TeamPeriod, fingerprint: string | null, inputs?: InputTrace): RequestCoverageProof | null {
+ +  if (!fingerprint || !confirmed(c)) return null;
+ +  return requestCoverageReceipt(receipts, dir, c!.confirmationRef!, period, fingerprint, inputs);
+ +}
+ +export function readComparisonEvidence(receipts: TeamReceiptReads, dir: string, period: unknown, reported: unknown, inputs?: InputTrace): void {
+ +  if (object(period) && typeof period.completionRef === "string") receipts.read(dir, period.completionRef, inputs);
+ +  if (!object(reported)) return;
+ +  if (typeof reported.ref === "string") receipts.read(dir, reported.ref, inputs);
+ +  if (Array.isArray(reported.support)) {
+ +    for (const item of referenceList(reported.support)) {
+ +      if (object(item) && typeof item.ref === "string") receipts.read(dir, item.ref, inputs);
+ +    }
+ +  }
+ +}
+ +export function matchRequestCoverageProof(receipts: TeamReceiptReads, dir: string, reported: unknown, period: TeamPeriod, facts: PortableRequestFacts, inputs?: InputTrace): boolean {
+ +  if (!object(reported) || Object.keys(reported).length !== 5) return false;
+ +  const { ref, inputSha256, receiptSha256, sourceSha256, support } = reported;
+ +  if (!shortText(ref, 240) || !hashValue(inputSha256) || !hashValue(receiptSha256) || !hashValue(sourceSha256) ||
+ +      !Array.isArray(support) || support.length > 32) return false;
+ +  const files: RequestSupportReceipt[] = [];
+ +  for (const item of support) {
+ +    if (!object(item) || Object.keys(item).length !== 2 || !shortText(item.ref, 240) || !hashValue(item.receiptSha256)) return false;
+ +    files.push({ ref: item.ref, receiptSha256: item.receiptSha256 });
+ +  }
+ +  if (portableRequestInputHash(sourceSha256, facts, files) !== inputSha256 || !readRequestSupportingReceipts(receipts, dir, files, period, inputs)) return false;
+ +  return requestCoverageReceipt(receipts, dir, ref, period, inputSha256, inputs, receiptSha256) !== null;
+ +}
+ +/** The legacy reader remains tolerant; an opted-in team snapshot must never turn an invalid row into zero. */
+ +export function readTeamEvents(dir: string, project: string, inputs?: InputTrace): ProjectEvent[] | null {
+ +  try {
+ +    const text = utf8(regularBytes(safeTeamPath(dir, "log.jsonl"), 32 * 1024 * 1024));
+ +    const events: ProjectEvent[] = [];
+ +    for (const line of text.split("\n")) {
+ +      if (!line.trim()) continue;
+ +      const value = strictJson(line);
+ +      fields(value, ["ts", "p", "t", "type", "by", "msg", "to", "requestId", "role", "ok", "src", "ref", "data"], ["ts", "p", "type", "by", "msg"]);
+ +      for (const key of ["ts", "p", "t", "type", "by", "msg", "to", "requestId", "src", "ref"]) if (value[key] !== undefined && typeof value[key] !== "string") throw new HandoffError("팀 사건의 문자열 필드에 다른 JSON 타입을 쓸 수 없다");
+ +      validateEvent(value as unknown as ProjectEvent);
+ +      if (value.p !== project) throw new HandoffError("다른 프로젝트의 사건 행");
+ +      events.push(value as unknown as ProjectEvent);
+ +    }
+ +    inputs?.record(join(dir, "log.jsonl"), inputHash(text));
+ +    return events.sort((a, b) => Date.parse(a.ts) - Date.parse(b.ts));
+ +  } catch (e) { if (e instanceof InputSnapshotError) throw e; if ((e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") { inputs?.absent?.(join(dir, "log.jsonl")); return null; } throw new HandoffError("팀 사건 로그 손상·미지원 형식: 총량 생성을 보류한다"); }

+ +export function comparisonContext(value: unknown): ComparisonContext {

+ +export function teamPeriod(value: unknown): TeamPeriod {
+ +  fields(value, ["start", "end", "unit", "closed", "completionRef"], ["start", "end", "unit", "closed"]);
+ +  if (!(value.start === null || iso(value.start)) || !iso(value.end) || !["project-start-to-merge", "representative-task"].includes(value.unit as string) || typeof value.closed !== "boolean" || value.start !== null && Date.parse(value.start as string) > Date.parse(value.end as string) || value.completionRef !== undefined && !shortText(value.completionRef, 240)) throw new HandoffError("팀 측정 구간/완료 형식 오류");

+ +export function readTeamInput(root: string, projectDir: string, inputs?: InputTrace, receipts = new TeamReceiptReads(), forCommit = false): TeamInput | null {
+ +  const path = safeTeamPath(root, `${projectDir}/${measurementFile}`); if (!existsSync(path)) { inputs?.absent?.(path); return null; }
+ +  const value = metadataJson(path, 32768, inputs), dir = join(root, projectDir);
+ +  fields(value, ["version", "comparison", "period", "counts", "observed_counts", "coverage", "request_coverage", "log_coverage", "quality_audit", "role_observations", "coordinator_answers"], ["version"]);
+ +  if (value.version !== 1) throw new HandoffError("팀 측정 입력 버전 미지원");
+ +  if (value.comparison !== undefined) comparisonContext(value.comparison);
+ +  const completionRef = value.period === undefined ? undefined : teamPeriod(value.period).completionRef;
+ +  const requestCoverage = value.request_coverage === undefined ? undefined : coverage(value.request_coverage);
+ +  const optionalRefs = new Set(requestCoverage ? coverageRefs(requestCoverage) : []);
+ +  if (completionRef) optionalRefs.add(completionRef);
+ +  for (const ref of optionalRefs) {
+ +    if (forCommit) receipts.require(dir, ref, inputs);
+ +    else receipts.read(dir, ref, inputs);
+ +  }
+ +  // A shared path has the same availability policy for every declared use in a report.
+ +  const checkCoverage = (value: unknown) => {
+ +    for (const ref of coverageRefs(coverage(value))) {
+ +      if (forCommit || !optionalRefs.has(ref)) receipts.require(dir, ref, inputs);
+ +    }
+ +  };
+ +  for (const key of ["counts", "observed_counts"] as const) if (value[key] !== undefined) {
+ +    fields(value[key], [...MANUAL_KEYS], []);
+ +    if (Object.values(value[key] as Record<string, unknown>).some((n) => !nullableNatural(n))) throw new HandoffError("팀 수치는 음수 없는 정수 또는 null이어야 한다");
+ +  }
+ +  if (value.coverage !== undefined) { fields(value.coverage, [...MANUAL_KEYS], []); Object.values(value.coverage).forEach(checkCoverage); }
+ +  if (value.log_coverage !== undefined) checkCoverage(value.log_coverage);
+ +  if (value.quality_audit !== undefined) {
+ +    fields(value.quality_audit, ["blocking_sum", "rereviews_after_fail", "coverage"]);
+ +    if (!nullableNatural(value.quality_audit.blocking_sum) || !nullableNatural(value.quality_audit.rereviews_after_fail)) throw new HandoffError("감사 품질 수치 오류");
+ +    checkCoverage(value.quality_audit.coverage);
+ +  }
+ +  for (const name of ["role_observations", "coordinator_answers"] as const) if (value[name] !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(value[name]) || value[name].length > 32)) throw new HandoffError("팀 관측 목록 한도/형식 오류");
+ +  if (Array.isArray(value.role_observations)) {
+ +    const roles = new Set<string>();
+ +    for (const r of value.role_observations) {
+ +      fields(r, ["role", "workMs", "outputTokens", "coverage"]);
+ +      if (!identifier(r.role) || roles.has(r.role) || !nullableNatural(r.workMs) || !Array.isArray(r.outputTokens) || r.outputTokens.length > 8) throw new HandoffError("역할별 관측 수치/중복 오류");
+ +      roles.add(r.role); const tools = new Set<string>();
+ +      for (const output of r.outputTokens) { fields(output, ["tool", "output"]); if (!shortText(output.tool, 96) || !["Claude Code", "Codex", "Gemini CLI", "Cursor", "Antigravity"].includes(output.tool) || tools.has(output.tool) || !nullableNatural(output.output)) throw new HandoffError("역할별 출력 관측 오류"); tools.add(output.tool); }
+ +      checkCoverage(r.coverage);
+ +    }
+ +  }
+ +  if (Array.isArray(value.coordinator_answers)) for (const a of value.coordinator_answers) { fields(a, ["requestId", "coverage"]); if (!identifier(a.requestId)) throw new HandoffError("코디네이터 답 요청 ID 오류"); checkCoverage(a.coverage); }
+ +  return value as unknown as TeamInput;
+ +}

+ +/** Commit eligibility is stricter than availability during a report. */
+ +export function assertTeamCommitReceipts(root: string, projectDir: string, projectId: string, inputs?: InputTrace, logProofInputs?: InputTrace): void {
+ +  const receipts = new TeamReceiptReads(), dir = join(root, projectDir);
+ +  readTeamInput(root, projectDir, inputs, receipts, true);
+ +  const events = readTeamEvents(dir, projectId, inputs) ?? [];
+ +  const proposals = new Set(observeHandoffLedger(root, projectId, projectDir, inputs).rows
+ +    .filter((row) => row.kind === "decision_request").map((row) => row.requestId));
+ +  for (const event of events) {

+ +    const nativeMirror = event.requestId !== undefined && (event.type === "question" || event.type === "escalation") && proposals.has(event.requestId);
+ +    if (ownerAnswer || nativeMirror) receipts.requireIfPresent(dir, event.ref, logProofInputs);
+ +  }
+ +  receipts.assertStable();
+ +}

+ +import { HandoffError } from "./handoff-files.ts";
+ +
+ +const opaque = "<!-- opaque block -->";
+ +const blank = (line: string) => /^[ \t]*$/.test(line);
+ +// CommonMark 0.31.2 §4.6: block starts differ from complete inline tags.
+ +const blockTags = new Set("address article aside base basefont blockquote body caption center col colgroup dd details dialog dir div dl dt fieldset figcaption figure footer form frame frameset h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 head header hr html iframe legend li link main menu menuitem nav noframes ol optgroup option p param search section summary table tbody td tfoot th thead title tr track ul".split(" "));
+ +const rawTags = new Set(["pre", "script", "style", "textarea"]);
+ +const attribute = String.raw`(?:[ \t]+[A-Za-z_:][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*(?:[ \t]*=[ \t]*(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s"'=<>\x60]+))?)*`;
+ +const openTag = new RegExp(String.raw`^ {0,3}<([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*)${attribute}[ \t]*/?>[ \t]*$`);
+ +const closeTag = /^ {0,3}<\/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*)[ \t]*>[ \t]*$/;
+ +function htmlStart(line: string, blockReady: boolean, cautious: boolean): { kind: string; uncertain: boolean } | null {
+ +  const raw = /^ {0,3}<(pre|script|style|textarea)(?=[ \t>]|\/>|$)/i.exec(line);
+ +  if (raw) return { kind: `raw:${raw[1]!.toLowerCase()}`, uncertain: false };
+ +  if (/^ {0,3}<!--/.test(line)) return { kind: "comment", uncertain: false };
+ +  if (/^ {0,3}<\?/.test(line)) return { kind: "pi", uncertain: false };
+ +  if (/^ {0,3}<![A-Za-z]/.test(line)) return { kind: "declaration", uncertain: false };
+ +  if (/^ {0,3}<!\[CDATA\[/.test(line)) return { kind: "cdata", uncertain: false };
+ +  const prefix = /^ {0,3}<\/?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*)(?=[ \t>]|\/>|$)/.exec(line);
+ +  if (prefix && blockTags.has(prefix[1]!.toLowerCase())) return { kind: "blank", uncertain: false };
+ +  const opened = openTag.exec(line), closed = closeTag.exec(line);
+ +  if ((closed || opened && !rawTags.has(opened[1]!.toLowerCase())) && (blockReady || cautious)) return { kind: "blank", uncertain: cautious };
+ +  return null;
+ +}
+ +function htmlEnded(kind: string, line: string): boolean {
+ +  return kind === "blank" ? blank(line) : kind.startsWith("raw:") ? line.toLowerCase().includes(`</${kind.slice(4)}>`) : kind === "comment" ? line.includes("-->") : kind === "pi" ? line.includes("?>") : kind === "cdata" ? line.includes("]]>") : line.includes(">");
+ +}
+ +const thematic = /^ {0,3}(?:(?:-[ \t]*){3,}|(?:\*[ \t]*){3,}|(?:_[ \t]*){3,})$/;
+ +const atx = /^ {0,3}(#{1,6})(?:[ \t]|$)/;
+ +function indentColumns(line: string, column = 0): number {
+ +  for (const char of line) {
+ +    if (char === " ") column++;
+ +    else if (char === "\t") column += 4 - column % 4;
+ +    else break;
+ +  }
+ +  return column;
+ +}
+ +function listItem(line: string): { column: number; delimiter: string } | undefined {
+ +  if (thematic.test(line)) return undefined;
+ +  const marker = /^ {0,3}(?:[-+*]|[0-9]{1,9}[.)])(?=[ \t]|$)/.exec(line)?.[0];
+ +  if (!marker) return undefined;
+ +  const remainder = line.slice(marker.length);
+ +  const content = indentColumns(remainder, marker.length);
+ +  const column = blank(remainder) || content - marker.length > 4 ? marker.length + 1 : content;
+ +  return { column, delimiter: marker.at(-1)! };
+ +}
+ +/** Projection for canonical metadata/ATX tables; uncertain standalone HTML ends a retrospective interval. */
+ +export function teamMarkdown(text: string, scope: "header" | "retrospective"): string {
+ +  const headerOnly = scope === "header", atxOnly = scope === "retrospective";
+ +  let fence: { char: string; length: number } | undefined, html: string | undefined, comment = false, indentedCode = false, blockReady = true, pipeBlock = false;
+ +  let headerEnded = false, firstTitle = false, headerParagraph = false;
+ +  let activeList: ReturnType<typeof listItem>;
+ +  const inline = (line: string): string => {
+ +    let out = "", at = 0;
+ +    while (at < line.length) {
+ +      if (comment) {
+ +        const end = line.indexOf("-->", at);
+ +        if (end < 0) return out;
+ +        at = end + 3; comment = false; out += " "; continue;
+ +      }
+ +      if (line[at] === "\\" && at + 1 < line.length) { out += line.slice(at, at + 2); at += 2; continue; }
+ +      if (/^<\/?[a-z][a-z0-9-]*(?:\s|\/?>)/i.test(line.slice(at))) {
+ +        let end = at + 1, quote = "";
+ +        for (; end < line.length; end++) { const char = line[end]!; if (quote) { if (char === quote) quote = ""; } else if (char === "\"" || char === "'") quote = char; else if (char === ">") { end++; break; } }
+ +        out += line.slice(at, end); at = end; continue;
+ +      }
+ +      if (line[at] === "`") {
+ +        const run = /^`+/.exec(line.slice(at))![0]; let end = at + run.length;
+ +        while ((end = line.indexOf(run, end)) >= 0) { if (line[end - 1] !== "`" && line[end + run.length] !== "`") break; end += run.length; }
+ +        if (end >= 0) { out += "x".repeat(end + run.length - at); at = end + run.length; continue; }
+ +        if (line.slice(at + run.length).includes("<!--")) throw new HandoffError("팀 Markdown의 여러 줄/미완성 코드와 주석 혼합은 일반 텍스트로 정리한다");
+ +        out += run; at += run.length; continue;
+ +      }
+ +      if (line.startsWith("<!--", at)) { comment = true; at += 4; out += " "; continue; }
+ +      out += line[at++]!;
+ +    }
+ +    return out;
+ +  };
+ +  return text.replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n").split("\n").map((line) => {
+ +    if (headerEnded) return "";
+ +    const priorBlockReady = blockReady; blockReady = blank(line);
+ +    const priorHeaderParagraph = headerParagraph; headerParagraph = false;
+ +    const indentation = indentColumns(line);
+ +    // Inline comments cannot escape their paragraph into a new block. Block comments use html above.
+ +    const interrupt = blank(line) || atx.test(line) || thematic.test(line) || /^ {0,3}(?:`{3,}|~{3,}|>|[-+*][ \t]+\S|0{0,8}1[.)][ \t]+\S)/.test(line) || !!htmlStart(line, false, false);
+ +    let withinList = false;
+ +    const insideOpaqueBlock = fence !== undefined || html !== undefined;
+ +    // An opaque block can end with its containing list; its contents cannot start a list.
+ +    if (!blank(line) && (activeList !== undefined || !insideOpaqueBlock)) {
+ +      const item = listItem(line);
+ +      const sibling = item && item.delimiter === activeList?.delimiter;
+ +      const lazyParagraph = !sibling && !priorBlockReady && !interrupt && !insideOpaqueBlock && !indentedCode;
+ +      withinList = !!activeList && (indentation >= activeList.column || lazyParagraph);
+ +      if (!withinList) {
+ +        // A code or HTML block opened in a list item ends with that item.
+ +        if (activeList) { fence = undefined; html = undefined; comment = false; indentedCode = false; }
+ +        // An ordinary paragraph can only be interrupted by an allowed list opener.
+ +        activeList = priorBlockReady || interrupt || sibling || insideOpaqueBlock ? item : undefined;
+ +      }
+ +    }
+ +    if (!line.startsWith("|")) pipeBlock = false;
+ +    if (fence) {
+ +      const close = /^ {0,3}([`~]+)[ \t]*$/.exec(line);
+ +      if (close && close[1]!.length >= fence.length && [...close[1]!].every((char) => char === fence!.char)) { fence = undefined; blockReady = true; }
+ +      return opaque;
+ +    }
+ +    if (html) { if (htmlEnded(html, line)) { html = undefined; blockReady = true; } return opaque; }
+ +    if (comment && interrupt) comment = false;
+ +    if (!comment && indentation >= 4 && (priorBlockReady || indentedCode)) { indentedCode = true; blockReady = true; return opaque; }
+ +    if (!comment && !blank(line)) indentedCode = false;
+ +    if (headerOnly && !comment) {
+ +      const heading = atx.exec(line);
+ +      if (heading && !withinList) {
+ +        if (heading[1]!.length > 1 || firstTitle) { headerEnded = true; return "## opaque boundary"; }
+ +        firstTitle = true;
+ +      }
+ +    }
+ +    if (!comment && /^ {1,3}#{1,6}(?:[ \t]|$)/.test(line)) return "<!-- unsupported indented heading -->";
+ +    if (!comment) {
+ +      const start = htmlStart(line, priorBlockReady, atxOnly);
+ +      if (start) { html = htmlEnded(start.kind, line) ? undefined : start.kind; if (!html) blockReady = true; return start.uncertain ? "## opaque HTML boundary" : opaque; }
+ +      const open = /^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})/.exec(line);
+ +      if (open && open[1]![0] === "`" && line.slice(open[0].length).includes("`")) throw new HandoffError("팀 Markdown의 backtick fence 정보는 backtick을 포함할 수 없다");
+ +      if (open) { fence = { char: open[1]![0]!, length: open[1]!.length }; return opaque; }
+ +    }
+ +    const continuedInlineComment = comment, visible = inline(line);
+ +    if (continuedInlineComment) return opaque;
+ +    if (comment) return line;
+ +    // Removing inline HTML must never invent a block marker absent in the source.
+ +    if (atx.test(visible) && !atx.test(line)) return line;
+ +    if (atx.test(visible)) blockReady = true;
+ +    const separator = /^ {0,3}(?:=+|(?:-[ \t]*)+|(?:\*[ \t]*)+|(?:_[ \t]*)+)$/.test(visible);
+ +    if (thematic.test(visible)) blockReady = true;
+ +    if (atxOnly && separator) return "<!-- unsupported underline -->";
+ +    if (headerOnly && /^ {0,3}(?:=+|-+)[ \t]*$/.test(visible)) {
+ +      if (priorHeaderParagraph && !withinList) { headerEnded = true; return "## opaque boundary"; }
+ +      return "<!-- opaque boundary -->";
+ +    }
+ +    if (atxOnly && line.startsWith("|")) {
+ +      if (!pipeBlock && !priorBlockReady) return opaque;
+ +      pipeBlock = true;
+ +      return line;
+ +    }
+ +    headerParagraph = headerOnly && !activeList && !interrupt && indentation < 4 && !blank(visible);
+ +    return visible;
+ +  }).join("\n");
+ +}

+ +function sumReviewed(rows: readonly ProjectEvent[], key: "blocking" | "should_fix", complete: boolean): number | null {
+ +  if (!complete) return null;
+ +  let total = 0;
+ +  for (const event of rows) {
+ +    total += event.data![key]!;
+ +    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total)) return null;
+ +  }
+ +  return total;
+ +}
+ +function completeGateEvent(event: ProjectEvent): boolean {
+ +  const keys = Object.keys(event.data ?? {}), cmd = keys[0];
+ +  if (keys.length !== 1 || !cmd || !["check", "done", "finish"].includes(cmd) || event.data?.[cmd] !== 1) return false;
+ +  if (event.ok === true) return event.msg === cmd;
+ +  return event.ok === false && gateFailureReasons.some((reason) => event.msg === `${cmd}: ${reason}`);
+ +}
+ +function periodFor(stats: FullStats, input: TeamInput | null, now: string, warnings: string[], events: readonly ProjectEvent[]): TeamPeriod {
+ +  const unit = input?.comparison?.unit ?? input?.period?.unit ?? "project-start-to-merge";
+ +  const nativeTimes = (type: "start" | "merge") => events.filter((e) => e.type === type && e.by === "cli" && e.ok === true && Date.parse(e.ts) <= Date.parse(now)).map((e) => e.ts).sort((a, b) => Date.parse(a) - Date.parse(b));
+ +  const nativeStart = nativeTimes("start")[0] ?? null, terminal = unit === "project-start-to-merge" ? nativeTimes("merge").at(-1) ?? null : stats.project.finish;
+ +  const start = unit === "project-start-to-merge" ? nativeStart : stats.project.start;
+ +  if (start && terminal && Date.parse(terminal) < Date.parse(start)) throw new HandoffError("팀 성공 종료 사건이 시작보다 앞선다");
+ +  if (!input?.period) return { start, end: terminal ?? now, unit, closed: unit === "project-start-to-merge" && !!terminal && !!start };
+ +  const p = { ...input.period };
+ +  if (p.unit !== unit || Date.parse(p.end) > Date.parse(now) || p.start && start && Date.parse(p.start) < Date.parse(start) || terminal && Date.parse(p.end) > Date.parse(terminal)) throw new HandoffError("팀 측정 선언 구간이 프로젝트/조회 범위를 벗어난다");
+ +  if (unit === "project-start-to-merge") {
+ +    if (start && p.start && Date.parse(p.start) !== Date.parse(start)) throw new HandoffError("프로젝트 start→merge 비교 구간 불일치");
+ +    p.start = start ?? p.start; p.end = terminal ?? now; p.closed = !!terminal && !!start;
+ +    if (!terminal || !start) { p.closed = false; warnings.push("실제 성공 start/merge 사건 없음: 프로젝트 전체 범위 미완료"); }
+ +  }
+ +  return p;
+ +}
+ +function measure(receipts: TeamReceiptReads, input: TeamInput | null, key: ManualKey, period: TeamPeriod, dir: string, scopeBound: boolean, inputs?: InputTrace): Measure {
+ +  const proposed = input?.counts?.[key] ?? null, values = input?.observed_counts;
+ +  const observed = values && Object.hasOwn(values, key) ? values[key] ?? null : proposed;
+ +  if (proposed !== null && observed !== null && observed > proposed) throw new HandoffError("관측 하한이 신고 총량보다 크다");
+ +  const proof = input?.coverage?.[key], total = scopeBound && period.closed && scopeConfirmed(receipts, dir, proof, period, key, inputs) ? proposed : null;
+ +  return { observed, total, coverage: total !== null ? "reported-complete" : observed !== null ? "reported-partial" : "uncollected", refs: proof?.refs ?? [] };
+ +}

+ +function tableCells(line: string): string[] | null {
+ +  const source = line.replace(/[ \t]+$/, "");
+ +  if (!source.startsWith("|")) return null;
+ +  const cells: string[] = []; let start = 1, backslashes = 0;
+ +  for (let i = 1; i < source.length; i++) {
+ +    const char = source[i];
+ +    if (char === "\\") { backslashes++; continue; }
+ +    if (char === "|" && backslashes % 2 === 0) { cells.push(source.slice(start, i).replace(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/g, "")); start = i + 1; }
+ +    backslashes = 0;
+ +  }
+ +  return start === source.length ? cells : null;
+ +}
+ +function cellInk(value: string): boolean {
+ +  // Default-ignorables and BRAILLE PATTERN BLANK cannot establish visible cell content.
+ +  let visible = value.replace(/[\s\p{M}\p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point}\u2800]/gu, "");
+ +  if (/[\p{M}\p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point}\u2800]/u.test(value)) visible = visible.replace(/[*_~\[\]]/g, "");
+ +  return !!visible;
+ +}
+ +function escapedPunctuation(value: string, at: number): boolean {
+ +  const n = value.charCodeAt(at + 1);
+ +  return value[at] === "\\" && (n >= 33 && n <= 47 || n >= 58 && n <= 64 || n >= 91 && n <= 96 || n >= 123 && n <= 126);
+ +}
+ +function bracketEnd(value: string, at: number): number {
+ +  let depth = 1;
+ +  for (let i = at + 1; i < value.length; i++) {
+ +    if (escapedPunctuation(value, i)) { i++; continue; }
+ +    if (value[i] === "[") depth++;
+ +    else if (value[i] === "]" && --depth === 0) return i;
+ +  }
+ +  return -1;
+ +}
+ +function destinationEnd(value: string, at: number): number {
+ +  const spaces = (pos: number) => { while (value[pos] === " " || value[pos] === "\t") pos++; return pos; };
+ +  const title = (pos: number): number => {
+ +    const opener = value[pos], closer = opener === "(" ? ")" : opener;
+ +    if (opener !== '"' && opener !== "'" && opener !== "(") return -1;
+ +    for (let i = pos + 1; i < value.length; i++) {
+ +      if (escapedPunctuation(value, i)) { i++; continue; }
+ +      if (value[i] === closer) return i + 1;
+ +      if (value[i] === "\r" || value[i] === "\n" || opener === "(" && value[i] === "(") return -1;
+ +    }
+ +    return -1;
+ +  };
+ +  const finishTitle = (pos: number) => { const end = title(pos); return end >= 0 && value[spaces(end)] === ")" ? spaces(end) : -1; };
+ +  const start = spaces(at + 1);
+ +  let pos = start, depth = 0;
+ +  if (value[pos] === "<") {
+ +    for (pos++; pos < value.length && value[pos] !== ">"; pos++) {
+ +      if (escapedPunctuation(value, pos)) { pos++; continue; }
+ +      if (value[pos] === "<" || value[pos] === "\r" || value[pos] === "\n") return -1;
+ +    }
+ +    if (value[pos++] !== ">") return -1;
+ +  } else {
+ +    for (; pos < value.length; pos++) {
+ +      if (escapedPunctuation(value, pos)) { pos++; continue; }
+ +      const char = value[pos]!;
+ +      if (char === " " || char === "\t" || char === ")" && depth === 0) break;
+ +      if (char.charCodeAt(0) < 32 || char.charCodeAt(0) === 127) return -1;
+ +      if (char === "(" && ++depth > 16) return -1;
+ +      if (char === ")") depth--;
+ +    }
+ +  }
+ +  if (depth === 0) {
+ +    const next = spaces(pos);
+ +    if (value[next] === ")") return next;
+ +    if (next > pos) { const end = finishTitle(next); if (end >= 0) return end; }
+ +  }
+ +  // Empty destination followed by a title is also valid CommonMark.
+ +  return finishTitle(start);
+ +}
+ +/** Projects the supported cell text without borrowing destination/title text as label ink. */
+ +function cellText(value: string, depth = 0): { text: string; valid: boolean } {
+ +  if (depth > 16) return { text: "", valid: false };
+ +  let text = "";
+ +  for (let i = 0; i < value.length;) {
+ +    if (escapedPunctuation(value, i)) { text += "x"; i += 2; continue; }
+ +    if (value[i] !== "[") { text += value[i++]!; continue; }
+ +    const end = bracketEnd(value, i);
+ +    if (end < 0) return { text, valid: false };
+ +    const label = cellText(value.slice(i + 1, end), depth + 1);
+ +    if (!label.valid) return { text, valid: false };
+ +    if (value[i - 1] === "!" && text.endsWith("!")) return { text, valid: false };
+ +    let next = end + 1, target = -1;
+ +    if (value[next] === "(") target = destinationEnd(value, next);
+ +    else { while (value[next] === " " || value[next] === "\t") next++; if (value[next] === "[") target = bracketEnd(value, next); }
+ +    if (value[end + 1] === "(" || value[next] === "[") {
+ +      if (target < 0 || !cellInk(label.text)) return { text, valid: false };
+ +      text += label.text; i = target + 1;
+ +    } else { text += `[${label.text}]`; i = end + 1; }
+ +  }
+ +  return { text, valid: true };
+ +}
+ +function usableText(value: string): boolean {
+ +  const projected = cellText(value);
+ +  return projected.valid && cellInk(projected.text) && !/[\p{Cc}\p{Cf}]/u.test(value) && !projected.text.includes("`") &&
+ +    !/<!--|<\?|<![A-Za-z]|<!\[CDATA\[|<\/?[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*(?=[ \t/>])(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^'"<>])*?>|&(?:#[xX]?[a-fA-F0-9]+|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+);/.test(projected.text);
+ +}
+ +function visibleTeamRows(close: string): string[] {
+ +  const lines: string[] = [], rows: string[] = []; let active = false;
+ +  for (const line of teamMarkdown(close, "retrospective").split("\n")) {

+ +    else lines.push(line);
+ +  }
+ +  if (lines.includes("<!-- unsupported underline -->")) throw new HandoffError("회고 표 구간은 ATX 제목만 사용한다: 밑줄·구분선·빈 목록처럼 기호만 있는 지원 밖 행을 ATX 제목 또는 빈 줄로 정리한다");
+ +  if (lines.includes("<!-- unsupported indented heading -->")) throw new HandoffError("회고 기계 구간의 제목은 열0에 쓴다: 목록 안/들여쓴 제목을 일반 텍스트로 정리한다");

+ +    if (accepted) for (let j = i + 2; j < end; j++) { const cells = tableCells(lines[j]!); if (cells?.length === 3 && cells[0] === "팀") rows.push(lines[j]!); }
+ +    i = end - 1;
+ +  }

+ +export function validateTeamRetrospective(root: string, projectDir: string, close: string, findings: KnownFinding[] = [], candidateRoles?: string[], period?: TeamPeriod, inputs?: InputTrace): void {
+ +  const dir = join(root, projectDir);

+ +  }

+ +    reportedFindings.set(r.code, r.count);
+ +  }
+ +  const events = readEvents(dir, inputs), declared = new Set(events.flatMap((e) => e.role ? [e.role.name] : []));
+ +  const ledger = observeHandoffLedger(root, projectDir.split("/").at(-1)!.slice(0, 4), projectDir, inputs);

+ +  for (const name of expectedRoles) if (!roles.has(name)) throw new HandoffError("회고에 알려진 미사용 검토 후보가 빠졌다");

+ +    if (v.noChangesReasonRef !== undefined) throw new HandoffError("정의 변경과 무변경 이유를 함께 둘 수 없다");

+ +export function teamRetrospectiveIssues(root: string, projectDir: string, findings: KnownFinding[] = [], candidateRoles?: string[], period?: TeamPeriod, inputs?: InputTrace, requireAdoption = false): string[] {

+ +function receipt(dir: string, name = "proof.json", period?: { start: string | null; end: string; unit: string }, requestId?: string) {

"representative-scope:fixture:synthetic-metadata" : "fixture:synthetic-metadata", hash: digest(`synthetic-local-not-copied:${JSON.stringify(period ?? null)}`), ...(requestId ? { requestId } : {}), ...(period ? { period: { start: period.start, end: period.end, unit: period.unit } } : {}) })); return name;

"team" : "no-team", definition: "reach-v1", unit: "representative-task", workType: "feature", sizeBand: "small", host: "codex", sampleCount: 2, recordingBoundary: "closed-task", qualitySource: "event-log", qualityScopeHash: digest("same-quality-scope") }, period: { start: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", end: "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z", unit: "representative-task", closed: true, completionRef: "completion.json" }, completionProofSha256: undefined as string | undefined, counts, observed_counts: {}, unknown: { request_events: 0 } };

+ +    HEAD: ["update-ref", "HEAD", concurrentHead, prior],

+ +      if (!fired && (lockOnly ? atPack : beforeRef)) {

+ +      return original(command, args, options);
+ +    };
+ +    syncBuiltinESMExports();
+ +  `);

+ +test("R74 미채택 첫 스테이징 직전 기준 브랜치가 채택하면 실제 Git 반영 없이 보류한다", () => {
+ +  const { f, worktree, dir } = mergeFixture("true", "true", false);
+ +  const git = (...args: string[]) => f.git("-C", worktree, ...args);
+ +  const baseRef = "refs/heads/main", originalBase = git("rev-parse", baseRef).stdout.trim();
+ +  const rel = `projects/${dir.split("/").at(-1)}`;
+ +  adoptTeamMetrics(f.root, rel);
+ +  assert.equal(f.git("add", "-A").status, 0);
+ +  assert.equal(f.git("commit", "-qm", "synthetic-concurrent-adoption").status, 0);
+ +  const teamBase = git("rev-parse", baseRef).stdout.trim();
+ +  assert.equal(git("update-ref", baseRef, originalBase, teamBase).status, 0);
+ +  recordEvent(dir, { ts: new Date().toISOString(), p: "P001", type: "answer", by: "user", msg: "Synthetic receipt", ref: "new-private-receipt.json" });
+ +  const receiptPath = join(dir, "new-private-receipt.json"), body = '{"version":1,"body":"Synthetic private sentence."}';
+ +  writeFileSync(receiptPath, body);
+ +  const head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout, objects = git("count-objects", "-v").stdout;
+ +  const index = git("diff", "--cached", "--binary").stdout;
+ +  const preload = join(tempDir("pace-legacy-stage-base-race-"), "inject.mjs");
+ +  writeFileSync(preload, `
+ +    import cp from "node:child_process";
+ +    import { syncBuiltinESMExports } from "node:module";
+ +    const spawn = cp.spawnSync;
+ +    let fired = false;
+ +    cp.spawnSync = function (command, args, options) {
+ +      const atLegacy = command === process.execPath && args[0]?.endsWith("team-finish-ref.ts") && args[1] === "legacy";
+ +      if (!fired && (atLegacy || command === "git" && args.includes("add") && args.includes("-A"))) {
+ +        fired = true;
+ +        const changed = spawn("git", ["-C", ${JSON.stringify(worktree)}, "update-ref", ${JSON.stringify(baseRef)}, ${JSON.stringify(teamBase)}, ${JSON.stringify(originalBase)}], { encoding: "utf8" });
+ +        if (changed.status !== 0) throw new Error(changed.stderr);
+ +      }
+ +      return spawn(command, args, options);
+ +    };
+ +    syncBuiltinESMExports();
+ +  `);
+ +  const stopped = runPace(["project", "finish", "P001"], { cwd: worktree, home: f.home, env: { NODE_OPTIONS: `--import=${pathToFileURL(preload).href}` } });
+ +  assert.notEqual(stopped.status, 0, stopped.stdout + stopped.stderr);
+ +  assert.equal(git("rev-parse", baseRef).stdout.trim(), teamBase);
+ +  assert.equal(git("rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout, head);
+ +  assert.equal(git("diff", "--cached", "--binary").stdout, index);
+ +  assert.equal(git("count-objects", "-v").stdout, objects);
+ +  assert.equal(readFileSync(receiptPath, "utf8"), body);
+ +});
+ +
+ +for (const denied of ["index", "objects"] as const) test(`R74 실제 ${denied} 반영 실패 시 기존 Git 상태를 보존한다`, () => {
+ +  const { f, worktree, dir, run } = mergeFixture();
+ +  const git = (...args: string[]) => f.git("-C", worktree, ...args);
+ +  const note = join(dir, "synthetic-index-note.txt");
+ +  writeFileSync(note, "Synthetic staged note.\n");
+ +  assert.equal(git("add", "--", note).status, 0);
+ +  const indexPath = git("rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--git-path", "index").stdout.trim();
+ +  const index = readFileSync(indexPath), head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout, objects = git("count-objects", "-v").stdout;
+ +  const preload = join(tempDir("pace-real-index-install-failure-"), "inject.mjs");
+ +  writeFileSync(preload, `
+ +    import cp from "node:child_process";
+ +    import fs from "node:fs";
+ +    import { syncBuiltinESMExports } from "node:module";
+ +    const denied = ${JSON.stringify(denied)};
+ +    const rename = fs.renameSync;
+ +    fs.renameSync = function (before, after) {
+ +      if (denied === "index" && after === ${JSON.stringify(indexPath)}) throw Object.assign(new Error("Synthetic real index install denied"), { code: "EACCES" });
+ +      return rename(before, after);
+ +    };
+ +    const spawn = cp.spawnSync;
+ +    cp.spawnSync = function (command, args, options) {
+ +      if (denied === "objects" && command === "git" && args.includes("index-pack") && args.includes("--stdin")) {
+ +        return { status: 1, stdout: "", stderr: "Synthetic verified pack install denied" };
+ +      }
+ +      return spawn(command, args, options);
+ +    };
+ +    syncBuiltinESMExports();
+ +  `);
+ +  const stopped = runPace(["project", "finish", "P001"], { cwd: worktree, home: f.home, env: { NODE_OPTIONS: `--import=${pathToFileURL(preload).href}` } });
+ +  assert.notEqual(stopped.status, 0, stopped.stdout + stopped.stderr);
+ +  assert.match(stopped.stdout + stopped.stderr, denied === "index" ? /Synthetic real index install denied/ : /검증한 팀 마감 Git 객체를 반영하지 못했다/);
+ +  assert.equal(git("rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout, head);
+ +  assert.deepEqual(readFileSync(indexPath), index);
+ +  assert.equal(git("count-objects", "-v").stdout, objects);
+ +  const finished = run("project", "finish", "P001");
+ +  assert.equal(finished.status, 0, finished.stdout + finished.stderr);
  +});
